brand.name: minmini
brand.tagline: Dresses for the slow, golden hours.

announcement: New: The Evening Edit has landed

hero.body: Small-batch dresses cut from honest fabrics and finished by hand. Made in limited runs, so what you wear stays a little bit yours.

edit.title: Pieces we can't stop reaching for
edit.body: Hand-picked by our studio this month — the dresses that went from sample rail to our own wardrobes.

lookbook.title: The Evening Edit
lookbook.quote: A dress should feel like the last hour of daylight — warm, unhurried, a little golden.
lookbook.body: Satin that pools the light, velvet that holds the night, and sequins that catch every candle. Our after-dark capsule, made in runs of just 60 pieces each.

values.title: Small batches
values.body: Every style is made in runs of 60–200 pieces. No mountains of deadstock.

values.title: Honest fabrics
values.body: Cotton, linen, chanderi and mulmul, sourced from mills we visit ourselves.

values.title: Made by hand
values.body: Block printers, embroiderers and tailors paid fairly, credited by name.

testimonials.name: Ananya R.
testimonials.quote: The satin slip fits like it was cut for me. I've worn it to two weddings and a birthday — compliments every time.

testimonials.name: Meher K.
testimonials.quote: Finally an anarkali that feels modern but still makes my nani teary-eyed. The gota border is stunning in person.

testimonials.name: Priya S.
testimonials.quote: Softest linen I own. The co-ord has become my airport uniform and my Sunday brunch outfit.

newsletter.title: First look at every drop
newsletter.body: Join 40,000 others who hear about new collections, studio stories and private sales before anyone else.

footer.note: Designed in Chennai. Made across India, in small batches.
